message: Function has multiple abnormal exit doors — use a single abnormal-exit path

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} abnormal exit doors — use a single raise/process-exit path

rationale: Abnormal exits (raise and process-terminating calls) must not fan out. Multiple return statements are the normal early-return idiom and are not abnormal exits. Pass is a no-op, not an exit. Yield/yield-from suspend generators and are not function exits. Language data-model methods (dunders) and property getters follow fixed protocols and are out of scope. Generator functions are out of scope for abnormal-exit counting of yields.
remediation: Keep at most one raise or process-terminating call per function. Prefer converting failures to an explicit result type instead of raising. Early returns remain allowed.
